decisions: Final community QA reproduced a rendered-label hydration mismatch: app tab Hentai Heaven versus actual accessible Hentai 🔞 Heaven. Text emoji changes into an img[alt] after hydration; textContent alone loses it. Canonicalize only rendered text plus image alternatives identically for discovering and validating account home tabs. Preserve exact owner/ordinal/name validation, reject changed names, and regress both emoji representations before accepting the actual named-community retry.

Final actual acceptance found a valid video poster visible in the timeline but lost when the same post's detail projection temporarily omitted it. Preserve only previously validated video-poster facts for the identical post/handle/current owner, at most5min and200 entries; never carry ordinary photos, invent URLs or renew the timestamp from a carried value. Re-key image cache entries by validated source as well as generation/post/index so refreshed metadata cannot reuse unrelated pixels. Regress owner/handle/expiry and non-video cases.

Actual Windows accessibility still exposes the off-canvas transport document although the screen is app-owned. Hide its body as well as its document root from accessibility; do not affect the Atsumi document or visible rendering, and verify the real app tree after rebuilding.

Real approved QA on neutral post2111521027914436723 confirms like/unlike and bookmark transitions, but exposes two independent bugs: stale automatic continuation after a reader expires and animated counters concatenating old/new digits. Recover a stale read cursor at most once through a newly validated reader, preserving same-generation view context; never retry social mutations. Prefer the observed accessible counter label over animated DOM text and regress both failures.

Restrict app, typed API, native boundary and DOM action adapter to like/bookmark only. Remove the reply composer and repost mutation button; keep a reply-thread viewing button and read-only repost count/context. Add regressions proving reply/repost never dispatch. Test only unselected reactions on a neutral current-account post and restore both to their original state; never remove existing likes/bookmarks.

The new clean-room layout regression passes 1920x1080 and 960x640 but reveals collection buttons clipped at320px because their flex container can shrink below content. Preserve the failure screenshots and prevent that container shrinking; allow a new row on narrow windows without changing desktop layout.

Retain the user's per-post sensitive-content reveal request in the clean-room adapter, using the prior exact contentWarning/sensitiveMediaWarning rule. Only ordinary Show/View controls inside a post qualify; never age, authentication, subscription, account privacy or browser safety gates. Do not call social action controls while loading.

Public DOM inspection confirms linkless quoted cards: visible User-Name spans, time and tweetText but no href/post ID. Preserve those as a separate validated quote preview, not a fabricated Post identity; image leases remain bound to the enclosing verified post. Do not silently omit the quote or enable mutations for an unknown ID.

Actual off-canvas rendering now hydrates video but blocked media requests immediately remove the native video/poster. Preserve only bounded publicly rendered poster facts before removal, keyed by exact post identity and current owner, and validate again in the native projection. Do not allow background streams, guess URLs, or read site internal state. Add regression for transient posters and cross-owner rejection.

Actual video failure remains after localized play intent: hidden reader never creates a video element. Adopt the already audited off-canvas child-renderer pattern (streaming/browser_auto_surface.rs) without coupling X to CHZZK state: fixed negative client-relative bounds, no auto-resize/focus/popups, native mute and media interception before navigation, close on privacy/suspend/account switch. Do not display the official document, invent resources, or keep a second background player streaming.

Actual app acceptance now confirms account Bookmarks at /i/history and a named home community tab load, including avatar and bookmark/repost state. Video still fails: rendered X uses the Korean play label 플레이하기 and only creates video/poster after playback intent. Inspect that public DOM, never guess video URLs; refresh the bounded post projection after explicit playback intent before matching an observed media resource.

StrictMode startup/re-entry must await native suspension completion before new loads or account status. Preserve invalidation guards rather than disabling StrictMode, relaxing owner validation, or masking stale failures. Add delayed-suspension regressions before actual cold-start verification.

Actual 19:56 KST inspection: account home tabs are DIV role=tab without href, not anchor links. Bind those tabs by native-known account, ordinal and exact observed label, and revalidate before selecting. Never invent a public community ID or replace these with recommended communities.

Actual projection diagnostics reproduced text-first hydration: the first snapshot has zero image elements, a later snapshot has avatar/media/bookmark controls. Wait for bounded settled rendered data and traverse the viewport without skipping unhydrated posts. Retain explicit timeouts and cancellation on tab changes.
